lines.gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲ ਪੁਰਖ ਪੂਰਨ ਮਨਹਿ ਚਿੰਦਿਆ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhagat vachhal purakh pooran manahi chi(n)diaa paaeeai ||
lines.translation: The Perfect Lord is the Lover of His devotees; He fulfills the desires of the mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਮ ਅੰਧ ਕੂਪ ਤੇ ਉਧਾਰੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: tam a(n)dh koop te udhaarai naam ma(n)n vasaaeeai ||
lines.translation: He lifts us up out of the deep, dark pit; enshrine His Name within your mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਰ ਸਿਧ ਗਣ ਗੰਧਰਬ ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨ ਗੁਣ ਅਨਿਕ ਭਗਤੀ ਗਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: sur sidh gan ga(n)dharab mun jan gun anik bhagatee gaaiaa ||
lines.translation: The gods, the Siddhas, the angels, the heavenly singers, the silent sages and the devotees sing Your countless Glorious Praises.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਹੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: binava(n)t naanak karahu kirapaa paarabraham har raaiaa ||2||
lines.translation: Prays Nanak, please be merciful to me, O Supreme Lord God, my King. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਚੇਤਿ ਮਨਾ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਸਰਬ ਕਲਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: chet manaa paarabraham paramesar sarab kalaa jin dhaaree ||
lines.translation: O my mind, be conscious of the Supreme Lord God, the Transcendent Lord, who wields all power.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰੁਣਾ ਮੈ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਘਟ ਘਟ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਅਧਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: karunaa mai samarath suaamee ghat ghat praan adhaaree ||
lines.translation: He is All-powerful, the Embodiment of compassion. He is the Master of each and every heart;

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਮਨ ਤਨ ਜੀਅ ਦਾਤਾ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: praan man tan jee daataa bea(n)t agam apaaro ||
lines.translation: He is the Support of the breath of life. He is the Giver of the breath of life, of mind, body and soul. He is Infinite, Inaccessible and Unfathomable.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਰਣਿ ਜੋਗੁ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਮੋਹਨੁ ਸਰਬ ਦੋਖ ਬਿਦਾਰੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: saran jog samarath mohan sarab dokh bidaaro ||
lines.translation: The All-powerful Lord is our Sanctuary; He is the Enticer of the mind, who banishes all sorrows.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰੋਗ ਸੋਗ ਸਭਿ ਦੋਖ ਬਿਨਸਹਿ ਜਪਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: rog sog sabh dokh binasahi japat naam muraaree ||
lines.translation: All illnesses, sufferings and pains are dispelled, by chanting the Name of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਹੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਸਮਰਥ ਸਭ ਕਲ ਧਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: binava(n)t naanak karahu kirapaa samarath sabh kal dhaaree ||3||
lines.translation: Prays Nanak, please be merciful to me, All-powerful Lord; You are the Wielder of all power. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ਮਨਾ ਅਚੁਤ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਚ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: gun gaau manaa achut abinaasee sabh te ooch daiaalaa ||
lines.translation: O my mind, sing the Glorious Praises of the Imperishable, Eternal, Merciful Master, the Highest of all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਸੰਭਰੁ ਦੇਵਨ ਕਉ ਏਕੈ ਸਰਬ ਕਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: bisa(n)bhar devan kau ekai sarab karai pratipaalaa ||
lines.translation: The One Lord is the Sustainer of the Universe, the Great Giver; He is the Cherisher of all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲ ਮਹਾ ਦਇਆਲ ਦਾਨਾ ਦਇਆ ਧਾਰੇ ਸਭ ਕਿਸੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: pratipaal mahaa daiaal daanaa daiaa dhaare sabh kisai ||
lines.translation: The Cherisher Lord is so very merciful and wise; He is compassionate to all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਲੁ ਕੰਟਕੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਨਾਸੈ ਜੀਅ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਬਸੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaal ka(n)tak lobh mohu naasai jee jaa kai prabh basai ||
lines.translation: The pains of death, greed and emotional attachment simply vanish, when God comes to dwell in the soul.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ ਦੇਵਾ ਸਫਲ ਸੇਵਾ ਭਈ ਪੂਰਨ ਘਾਲਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: suprasa(n)n devaa saphal sevaa bhaee pooran ghaalaa ||
lines.translation: When the Lord is thoroughly pleased, then one's service becomes perfectly fruitful.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤ ਨਾਨਕ ਇਛ ਪੁਨੀ ਜਪਤ ਦੀਨ ਦੈਆਲਾ ॥੪॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: binava(n)t naanak ichh punee japat deen daiaalaa ||4||3||
lines.translation: Prays Nanak, my desires are fulfilled by meditating on the Lord, Merciful to the meek. ||4||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਸਖੀਏ ਮਿਲਿ ਉਦਮੁ ਕਰੇਹਾ ਮਨਾਇ ਲੈਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੰਤੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: sun sakheee mil udam karehaa manaai laihi har ka(n)tai ||
lines.translation: Listen, O my companions: let's join together and make the effort, to surrender to our Husband Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਨੁ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਕਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਠਗਉਰੀ ਮੋਹਹ ਸਾਧੂ ਮੰਤੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: maan tiaag kar bhagat thagauree mohah saadhoo ma(n)tai ||
lines.translation: Renouncing our pride, let's charm Him with the potion of devotional worship, and the mantra of the Holy Saints.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਖੀ ਵਸਿ ਆਇਆ ਫਿਰਿ ਛੋਡਿ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਇਹ ਰੀਤਿ ਭਲੀ ਭਗਵੰਤੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: sakhee vas aaiaa phir chhod na jaaee ih reet bhalee bhagava(n)tai ||
lines.translation: O my companions, when He comes under our power, He shall never leave us again. This is the good nature of the Lord God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਰਾ ਮਰਣ ਭੈ ਨਰਕ ਨਿਵਾਰੈ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਕਰੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਜੰਤੈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak jaraa maran bhai narak nivaarai puneet karai tis ja(n)tai ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, God dispels the fear of old age, death and hell; He purifies His beings. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਸਖੀਏ ਇਹ ਭਲੀ ਬਿਨੰਤੀ ਏਹੁ ਮਤਾਂਤੁ ਪਕਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: sun sakheee ih bhalee bina(n)tee ehu mataa(n)t pakaaeeai ||
lines.translation: Listen, O my companions, to my sincere prayer: let's make this firm resolve.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ਉਪਾਧਿ ਰਹਤ ਹੋਇ ਗੀਤ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਹਿ ਗਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: sahaj subhaai upaadh rahat hoi geet govi(n)dahi gaaeeai ||
lines.translation: In the peaceful poise of intuitive bliss, violence will be gone, as we sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਲਿ ਕਲੇਸ ਮਿਟਹਿ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਨਾਸਹਿ ਮਨਿ ਚਿੰਦਿਆ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: kal kales mitahi bhram naasahi man chi(n)diaa phal paaeeai ||
lines.translation: Our pains and troubles shall be eradicated, and our doubts shall be dispelled; we will receive the fruits of our minds' desires.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪੂਰਨ ਪਰਮੇਸਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: paarabraham pooran paramesar naanak naam dhiaaeeai ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Supreme Lord God, the Perfect, Transcendent Lord. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਖੀ ਇਛ ਕਰੀ ਨਿਤ ਸੁਖ ਮਨਾਈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੀ ਆਸ ਪੁਜਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: sakhee ichh karee nit sukh manaaee prabh meree aas pujaae ||
lines.translation: O my companions, I yearn for Him continually; I invoke His Blessings, and pray that God may fulfill my hopes.

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਪਿਆਸੀ ਦਰਸ ਬੈਰਾਗਨਿ ਪੇਖਉ ਥਾਨ ਸਬਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: charan piaasee daras bairaagan pekhau thaan sabaae ||
lines.translation: I thirst for His Feet, and I long for the Blessed Vision of His Darshan; I look for Him everywhere.

lines.gurmukhi: ਖੋਜਿ ਲਹਉ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਸੰਗੁ ਸੰਮ੍ਰਿਥ ਪੁਰਖ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: khoj lahau har sa(n)t janaa sa(n)g sa(n)mrith purakh milaae ||
lines.translation: I search for traces of the Lord in the Society of the Saints; they will unite me with the All-powerful Primal Lord God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸੁਰਿਜਨੁ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਸੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਮਾਏ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: naanak tin miliaa surijan sukhadaataa se vadabhaagee maae ||3||
lines.translation: O Nanak, those humble, noble beings who meet the Lord, the Giver of peace, are very blessed, O my mother. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਖੀ ਨਾਲਿ ਵਸਾ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਨਾਹ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਹਿਲਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: sakhee naal vasaa apune naah piaare meraa man tan har sa(n)g hiliaa ||
lines.translation: O my companions, now I dwell with my Beloved Husband; my mind and body are attuned to the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਸਖੀਏ ਮੇਰੀ ਨੀਦ ਭਲੀ ਮੈ ਆਪਨੜਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: sun sakheee meree need bhalee mai aapanaRaa pir miliaa ||
lines.translation: Listen, O my companions: now I sleep well, since I found my Husband Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਖੋਇਓ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ਭਇਆ ਕਉਲੁ ਖਿਲਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhram khoio saa(n)t sahaj suaamee paragaas bhaiaa kaul khiliaa ||
lines.translation: My doubts have been dispelled, and I have found intuitive peace and tranquility through my Lord and Master. I have been enlightened, and my heart-lotus has blossomed forth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋਹਾਗੁ ਨ ਟਲਿਆ ॥੪॥੪॥੨॥੫॥੧੧॥
lines.transliteration: var paaiaa prabh a(n)tarajaamee naanak sohaag na taliaa ||4||4||2||5||11||
lines.translation: I have obtained God, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts, as my Husband; O Nanak, my marriage shall last forever. ||4||4||2||5||11||
